verdict.rationale: Kushki markets its own hosted redirect option: 'Botón de pagos' redirects payments to a secure portal, and Smartlink creates customizable payment links. Both let a developer send customers to a vendor-hosted page instead of building a payment UI. The evidence is only one-line marketing headlines, with no integration docs for the redirect flow and nothing showing the page is conversion-optimized. Missing for 10: developer docs for the hosted redirect/checkout flow (session creation, return URLs, callbacks), evidence of conversion optimization (e.g. saved methods, localization, mobile UX), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
